name: Barilium
sum: An iguanodontian of the Early Cretaceous of southern England, once Iguanodon dawsoni and made a separate genus in 2010.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; collected by Charles Dawson in the 1880s.
material: Specimens from the Wadhurst Clay, Weald Clay and Tunbridge Wells Sand.
biology: Not described in the sources consulted.
author: Norman 2010
